desc: Gain Rapid Access. The patented V70 Speed Flashlight Holster allows the user to quickly access the flashlight from either a head-up or head-down position. Rigid polymer construction protects your light from impact while ensuring an "open mouth" for fumble-free re-holstering. An adjustable spacer allows the molded-in belt slot to be fitted to belts up to 2.25 inches wide.
